QUOTE: "It then calls `client.createPost` again with the same content. ... On failure it sets `failed: true` again, or deletes the post if the error is one of the three removal errors above. It does not retry on its own."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that retryFailedPost makes a single new createPost call, with no automatic retry, and that on failure it re-marks the post failed or deletes it for the same three errors.
